0022600193.text: The Warriors, 6-3 and riding a six-game win streak, host the 2-6 Orlando Magic in their 10th game of the season, with Golden State 4-1 at home and Orlando 0-4 on the road... wait, Orlando's road record is 2-2, so the Magic are 0-4 at home. Golden State are 2nd in the Pacific, 1.5 games back and 8th in the West, while Orlando are 5th in the Southeast, 3 games back and 12th in the East, having lost three straight. Golden State are without Jimmy Butler III (knee, surgery), Kristaps Porzingis (illness) and Moses Moody (knee, surgery), and Draymond Green (elbow inflammation), Gary Payton II (calf) and Gui Santos (knee) are day-to-day with game-time decisions, while Orlando are missing Izaiyah Nelson (ankle, surgery), Jalen Suggs (knee), Jonathan Isaac (knee), Noah Penda (hamstring strain) and Paolo Banchero (ankle sprain). The teams have not met yet in 2026-27, after splitting their 2025-26 series 1-1, and the Warriors won their last meeting 120-97 in San Francisco on December 22, 2025.
